original_excerpt: The aim of this study was to develop and validate the Artificial Intelligence Self-Efficacy Scale for Teachers (AISES-T). … Data were collected from teachers in different regions of Turkiye within a scale development design. … Following expert review, a pool of 50 items was reduced to a 27-item trial form. … Exploratory factor analysis (EFA) using principal axis factoring was conducted in a first sample of 313 teachers, and confirmatory factor analysis (CFA) was conducted in a second, independent sample of 559 teachers. … Participants were teachers employed in schools in different regions of Türkiye.
interpretation_note: 轉述作者摘要的研究目的、資料蒐集、題項發展與兩階段因素分析樣本；因素結構的適配指標與信效度數值不寫入。

summary_evidence_spans: The aim of this study was to develop and validate the Artificial Intelligence Self-Efficacy Scale for Teachers (AISES-T).
Data were collected from teachers in different regions of Turkiye within a scale development design.
Following expert review, a pool of 50 items was reduced to a 27-item trial form.

Exploratory factor analysis (EFA) using principal axis factoring was conducted in a first sample of 313 teachers, and confirmatory factor analysis (CFA) was conducted in a second, independent sample of 559 teachers.
Participants were teachers employed in schools in different regions of Türkiye.

summary_evidence_spans: This study examines the short-term educational contribution of teacher-guided generative tutoring through a secondary analysis of a randomized trial in nine public secondary schools in Benin City, Nigeria.
Among 1328 randomized students, 657 were offered twelve 90 min sessions combining Microsoft Copilot, curriculum-aligned English activities, and pair work, while 671 received regular instruction.

The source we chose is the World Bank’s RR_NGA_2025_349 reproducibility package, associated with the working paper by De Simone et al. (2025a) and registered with DOI 10.60572/cre7-j348 (De Simone et al., 2025b).

claim_text: 來源機構：Education Sciences (MDPI)；資料標題：A Human–AI Orchestration Framework for Mathematics Education；來源刊登日：2026-10-22。作者摘要報告：研究提出整合智慧教學系統、生成式 AI 與教師直接支援的「人機教學調度架構」，教學調度與責任仍由教師承擔；以認知負荷理論為基礎，提出「認知負荷重新分配」理論命題，以及交接點、後設提示等協調機制；並在真實課堂以 32 名八年級學生進行探索性設計試行，探討其實務實施，依觀察與回饋反覆調整配置。（AI 輔助摘要，未經真人逐則審稿；請參閱原文。）

original_excerpt: This study proposes a Human–AI Orchestration Framework integrating Intelligent Tutoring Systems (ITSs), Generative AI, and direct teacher support while retaining pedagogical orchestration and responsibility with the teacher. … Drawing on Cognitive Load Theory, the Framework proposes Cognitive Load Redistribution as a theoretical proposition and introduces coordination mechanisms, including Handover Points and a Meta-Prompt. … Its practical implementation was explored through an exploratory design pilot with 32 Grade 8 students in an authentic classroom, using observations and feedback to iteratively refine its configuration.
interpretation_note: 轉述作者摘要的架構組成、理論依據、協調機制與試行設計；試行為形成性觀察，作者寫明教育成效與所提機制有待後續系統評估，不寫成效。
scope_limitation: 同儕審查期刊論文（Education Sciences，監測清單 J47）；框架提案加探索性設計試行，試行為以色列海法一所公立宗教男校的單一班級（該校八年級最高程度數學組）32 名男生、為期六週，未評估學習成效，結果不宜推論。

ai_lit_note: 整合智慧教學系統、生成式 AI 與教師支援的數學教學框架，屬 AI 賦能教與學（B），對應 T-TEA「設計AI與教學法整合的策略」、S-LRN「應用AI工具強化領域學習」
summary_evidence_spans: This study proposes a Human–AI Orchestration Framework integrating Intelligent Tutoring Systems (ITSs), Generative AI, and direct teacher support while retaining pedagogical orchestration and responsibility with the teacher.

Drawing on Cognitive Load Theory, the Framework proposes Cognitive Load Redistribution as a theoretical proposition and introduces coordination mechanisms, including Handover Points and a Meta-Prompt.

Its practical implementation was explored through an exploratory design pilot with 32 Grade 8 students in an authentic classroom, using observations and feedback to iteratively refine its configuration.
attributed_summary: 研究提出整合智慧教學系統、生成式 AI 與教師直接支援的「人機教學調度架構」，教學調度與責任仍由教師承擔；以認知負荷理論為基礎，提出「認知負荷重新分配」理論命題，以及交接點、後設提示等協調機制；並在真實課堂以 32 名八年級學生進行探索性設計試行，探討其實務實施，依觀察與回饋反覆調整配置。
